policy: Reserve before each exposed call; stop and record a failure, without automatic retry or sampling to erase it. Any remediation recheck requires a new pre-execution record within Delivery limits. Three calls give existence evidence, not a reliability rate.

cases.text:
Patient DEMO-91 is a 54-year-old woman who took ibuprofen for back pain and developed melena on 11 September 2026. I suspect ibuprofen.
Her hemoglobin was 9.1 g/dL, reference range 12 to 16, on 11 September 2026. A stool test was positive for occult blood on the same date.
Her platelet count was 82; I don’t have its units or collection date. Ferritin was tested, but I don’t have the result or date.
There was also a separate negative test, but I don’t have its name or date available.
cases.expected: Five distinct tests: hemoglobin 9.1 g/dL with range 12–16 and date 2026-09-11; stool occult blood positive on the same date; platelet count 82 without inferred units/date; ferritin with unavailable result/date; separate unnamed negative test with unavailable date. Exact original supporting excerpts; no quarantine.

cases.text: I’ve now located the report for the unidentified negative test. It was a Helicobacter pylori stool antigen test. Its collection date is still unavailable. Also, I misread the hemoglobin: it was 8.9 g/dL, not 9.1. The hemoglobin reference range and date were correct.
cases.expected: From initial review, link the existing unnamed test to Helicobacter pylori stool antigen and change only hemoglobin result to 8.9 g/dL. No duplicate tests, no premature acceptance or direct edits. Other test facts, dates, range, negative result and unknowns retained. Review updates and independently read downloaded PDF.

cases.text: Patient DEMO-96-C is a 63-year-old man who developed a rash while taking allopurinol for gout. I suspect allopurinol. Serum β marker was ≥ 4 µg/L (reference range 2–6) on 12 September 2026. The urine culture collected that same day showed no growth. Platelets were not tested. A ferritin test was performed, but its result and collection date aren’t available.
cases.expected: Serum β marker ≥ 4 µg/L, range 2–6, 2026-09-12; urine culture no growth on that same date; ferritin with unavailable result/date. Do not invent a performed platelet measurement. Greek/inequality output faithful in PDF. Source support and clinical attribution assessed separately.
